findings.title: Zero authentication on SSE endpoint
findings.architecture_impact: Any client that can reach the host can open a session without credentials.

findings.title: Wildcard CORS on token endpoint
findings.observed: ACAO star returned on a non-credentialed error response
findings.architecture_impact: A cross-origin reader sees the error body of the token endpoint.
findings.remediation: Allowlist origins on the token endpoint.
findings.retest_criteria: No ACAO header on a cross-origin request.
